title: Fluoroscopic image-driven deep learning model for predicting intussusception irreducibility during air enema in children.
summary: A hybrid deep-learning model predicts irreducible pediatric intussusception from fluoroscopic air-enema images; real-world and external test AUCs were 0.89 and 0.883, and assistance improved radiologist performance. This is a retrospective diagnostic result, with only nine irreducible external cases.
